item.title: Issue #3066 created
item.description:
Node constructors: JNodes

We have already adapted the map constructors rules for JNodes, but didn’t look at other constructors yet:

node() now matches JNodes too, so the rule “For each node returned by an enclosed expression, a new copy is made…” applies, but a JNode can’t be copied into an XML tree.

Examples:

<a>{ { 'x': 'y' }/x }</a>
<a>{ [ <b/> ]/1 }</a>
<a>{ [ [ 1, 2 ] ]/1 }</a>

I think we should replace each JNode by its ·jvalue·. The existing rules then apply: atomic items become text, XNodes are copied, arrays are flattened, and maps raise XQTY0105. The results for the examples would be:

<a>y</a>`
<a><b/></a>
<a>1 2</a>
